`final class Tessellator`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.render.tessellator` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Tessellator.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/render/tessellator/Tessellator.java)

Collects vertices with optional texture coordinates, colors and normals, and sends them to the render bridge in one draw.

## Description

Start a shape, give it its vertices, then draw it:

```java fragment
final Tessellator tessellator = Tessellator.inst();
tessellator.start(DrawMode.TRIANGLES);
tessellator.addVertexWithUV(0D, 0D, 0D, 0D, 0D);
...
tessellator.draw();
```

It draws with the current render state: the bound texture, the bound shader and the current color, which tints the vertices.
A texture coordinate, a color or a normal applies to every vertex added after it, until you set another one.
Lines wider than one pixel, or smoothed lines, draw as triangles with round joints.
It is not thread-safe: use it on the render thread only.

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `void` | [start](#Tessellator-method-start)(DrawMode drawMode) | Starts a shape joined as `drawMode`, without texture coordinates, colors or normals. |
| `void` | [draw](#Tessellator-method-draw)() | Sends the shape to the render bridge and ends it. |
| `void` | [abort](#Tessellator-method-abort)() | Ends the shape without drawing it, for example after an exception in the middle of a shape. |

## Method details

<a id="Tessellator-method-start"></a>

### start

`void start(DrawMode drawMode)` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: The Tessellator is already tessellating a … shape, call draw() to end it before start(…)

Starts a shape joined as `drawMode`, without texture coordinates, colors or normals.
Throws `IllegalStateException` while another shape is started.

<a id="Tessellator-method-draw"></a>

### draw

`void draw()` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: The Tessellator has no shape to draw, call start(DrawMode) before draw()

Sends the shape to the render bridge and ends it.
Throws `IllegalStateException` when no shape is started.

<a id="Tessellator-method-abort"></a>

### abort

`void abort()` 

Ends the shape without drawing it, for example after an exception in the middle of a shape.
